text:
ella_cs: Heads-up: Peregrine onboarding hitting short 429 spike during Cloud Run scale-up. They use Go SDK v0.3.0 and request a token from their auth proxy on container start. When revision scales from 1->20 they say ~10% of initial requests return 429 for ~30s. Any fast mitigations?

raj_engineer: Classic preflight stampede but on Cloud Run. Ask for sample request-ids+headers; also confirm whether the auth proxy is rate-limiting token minting.

ella_cs: Customer logs (sanitized):
```
2024-07-28T18:02:10Z id=px101 POST /v1/embeddings 200
2024-07-28T18:02:11Z id=px102 POST /v1/embeddings 429 X-RateLimit-Remaining:0
2024-07-28T18:02:11Z id=px103 POST /v1/embeddings 429 X-RateLimit-Remaining:0
```

sam_platform: If their auth proxy mints short-lived tokens per container, many containers calling at same time will hit our preflight limits. Quick client fixes: implement single-flight token fetch per instance (mutex) or use a tiny file-based cache in /tmp to reuse tokens between process restarts on the same container. Also add a staggered startup backoff (0-500ms random) before the first outbound call.

raj_engineer: For Go specifically: use golang.org/x/sync/singleflight or a small sync.Once + TTL refresh routine. Example: on init, attempt to read /tmp/redwood_token; if missing, fetch and write atomically. Also ensure the SDK's built-in backoff is enabled; older v0.3.0 had a conservative jitter bug so recommend v0.3.2.

maria_ops: Operational tip: if they control deployment, roll out in smaller concurrency batches (maxSurge/parallelism) so not all containers start simultaneously. Alternatively, prewarm a single helper container to perform token fetches and proxy traffic during ramp.

ella_cs: Can someone paste a 2-line blurb I can send to their SRE?

raj_engineer: Send this: "Short-term fixes for Cloud Run scale spikes: (1) Upgrade Go SDK to v0.3.2+; (2) implement single-flight token fetch or /tmp token cache per container; (3) add randomized init jitter (0-500ms) before first SDK call; (4) if possible, roll deploys in smaller parallel batches. These steps serialize token minting and eliminate transient 429s without server changes."

ella_cs: Sent. Customer applied jitter + single-flight and reported immediate improvement. They plan SDK upgrade next week.

sam_platform: I'll file a follow-up to add Cloud Run patterns into the onboarding playbook and check if we need a small server-side grace for new accounts.

infra-bot: Ticket created CS-9402: Add Cloud Run token-cache patterns to onboarding docs and track SDK upgrade nudges.

ella_cs: Closing thread; will reopen if they see regressions. Thanks all.
